## 1. Authorities launched multiple probes after the deadliest prison unrest in years.

Investigators from specialised crime units opened parallel inquiries, and <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">a three‑member committee with a retired apex court judge</span> began an independent review. Rights officials also announced they were examining allegations that transferred detainees suffered ill‑treatment and that monitors were briefly denied entry during night‑time checks.

Officials confirmed that <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">security equipment including a body scanner and surveillance cameras was smashed</span>, and that selected prisoners were relocated to higher‑security facilities. Lawmakers cited chronic overcrowding and staffing gaps, and outlined <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">plans to expand capacity by roughly 10,000 places</span> and to draft <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">a House Arrest Bill to enable electronic monitoring</span> in suitable remand cases.

## 2. Officials reported a sharp rise in dengue cases and deaths nationwide.

Health data showed the tally had reached <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">65,034 infections and 45 fatalities</span> by 9 July, with <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">about 1,300 new patients</span> logged in a single day. Major hospitals reported congestion, while district inspectors said even frontline staff had fallen ill and courts imposed <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">Rs. 12.25 million in fines</span> in June for breeding‑site violations.

Policymakers said they were assessing an internationally used vaccine and the Wolbachia method (a biological control that uses bacteria inside mosquitoes to reduce virus transmission). Clinicians noted that a licensed shot demonstrated <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">over 90% effectiveness against the prevailing type 2 strain</span> in trials conducted in the country, and authorities signalled readiness to deploy targeted units and dedicated high‑dependency care.

## 3. Research houses forecast muted earnings in 2026 before a rebound next year.

Analysts maintained an <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">8.2% growth outlook</span> for corporate profits this year after a 25.5% surge in 2025, citing high input costs, tariff revisions and currency volatility compressing margins. Quarterly results already showed <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">a third straight decline</span>, with the food, beverage and tobacco segment dragging the aggregate, while banks were seen as relatively resilient on repricing dynamics. Equities were expected to trade sideways within historical valuation bands through year‑end as fixed‑income yields compete for capital.

## 4. Lawmakers approved stronger anti‑money‑laundering enforcement at second reading.

The bill passed with <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">154 votes in favour and two against</span>, and will require <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">a special majority</span> before enactment. The reform is part of a broader effort ahead of the next mutual evaluation by international standard‑setters.

A drafting committee was appointed to prepare <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">a House Arrest Bill</span>, while administrators acknowledged <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">delays at the analyst’s department</span> and bail pathways for minor possession cases as <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">pressure points</span>. ## 7. Officials moved to restore a key wildlife corridor in the North Central dry zone.

An inter‑agency meeting agreed to <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">clear traditional routes</span> linking forest blocks around Mahakanadarawa, Nachchaduwa and Mahawilachchiya, and to use <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">GPS and satellite tracking</span> to map movements. ## 9. Supervision was extended on a primary‑dealer firm at the centre of past bond scandals.

Regulators renewed a <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">six‑month suspension</span> <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">from 5 July</span> to <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">continue investigations</span> under debt‑securities law.
